description: Currency exchange rates from the European Central Bank: euro reference rates for 29 currencies plus EUR (USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, CNY...), latest or any day in the last 90 days, with cross rates for any base and optional amount conversion (e.g. 100 USD to EUR). Use for invoicing, pricing and reporting. Reference rates, not transaction rates. Source: ECB; free at ecb.europa.eu. Signed receipt. Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"base":"USD","symbols":"EUR,GBP,JPY"}.

date.description: Rate date YYYY-MM-DD within the last 90 days; default latest

name: fx_reference_rates

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: ECB reference rates for the base currency on the rate date, optional converted amounts

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: ECB Currency Exchange Rates
